title: Game Of Life - 16:9
description:
This toy box wallpaper is an interactive implementation of conway's game of life. You can draw on the pixel grid while the game is unfolding. Buttons in the top-right let you control the animation speed or step through each iteration frame by frame. You can spawn in common structures like the glider with the stamp tool, and even design your own patterns to copy-paste in the blueprint area in the bottom-right.

As always I took care to provide as many customization options as possible. You can change stuff like the pixel size and the [url=https://conwaylife.com/wiki/Rulestring]rulestring[/url] that the game follows ([url=https://conwaylife.com/wiki/List_of_Life-like_rules]here[/url] is a list of interesting rule-sets if you want to experiment). I've also included a few optional post processing effects that you can turn on and play around with.

The whole wallpaper builds on top of a slightly modified version of my [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3352017535]Canvas Asset[/url]. I made it to showcase what's possible if you use the canvas in a creative way.

Other assets that I used in the wallpaper:
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2906937488]Procedural noise[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/capitan-willy-1]Gariam[/url]
